goal: Prevent redundant connection attempts, DNS lookups, and log spam caused by duplicate startup node entries
Deduplicate repeated startup peer addresses, including hostnames specified with and without default ports
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Supported ignoring repeated entries and using numeric IP deduplication (danielabrozzoni)
Supported deduplication after adding default-port equivalence checks (pablomartin4btc)
Verified deduplication behavior with default ports on regtest (AndreaDiazCorreia)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it avoids wasted DNS queries, connection attempts, and log spam from duplicate node entries
The benefit is limited to redundant startup node arguments while peers remain disconnected
